name: Onam
note: Harvest festival: Sadya feasts, flower carpets (pookalam), boat races and dances. Dates follow the Malayalam calendar (month of Chingam).

name: Nehru Trophy Boat Race
note: The best-known snake-boat race. Traditionally in August, but recent races moved later, so check the year's date before booking.

name: Champions Boat League
note: A league of snake-boat races held on weekends. Check the official schedule for venues.

name: Thrissur Pooram
note: Caparisoned elephants, huge percussion ensembles and fireworks. Extremely crowded; book rooms months ahead.

name: Theyyam season
note: Ritual performances in village shrines, often through the night. Use the official Theyyam calendar to find dates.

name: Sabarimala pilgrimage season
note: Mandala–Makaravilakku season from mid-November to mid-January. Expect heavy traffic on routes to the hills.

name: Vishu
note: Malayalam new year in mid-April, with the Vishukkani display and fireworks.

name: Cochin Carnival
note: Street celebrations in the last days of December, ending on New Year's Eve.

name: Christmas
note: Kerala has a large Christian community; churches and streets are lit up.

name: Kochi-Muziris Biennale
note: Contemporary art festival held every two years. Check whether your trip falls in a Biennale year.

name: Attukal Pongala
note: Huge gathering of women cooking offerings on the city streets.

name: Aranmula Boat Race
note: A ritual snake-boat procession during Onam season.

name: Monsoon festivals
note: Kerala Tourism runs monsoon-season events; also the traditional season for Ayurveda.
